title: Task Scheduler
statement:
You are given a list of tasks represented as uppercase letters, and a non-negative cooldown integer N.

The CPU must wait at least N intervals between two executions of the same task. During the wait, it can execute other tasks or sit idle.

Find the minimum number of intervals needed to finish all tasks.

Hint: the answer is max(total tasks, (max_freq - 1) * (N + 1) + count_of_max_freq_tasks).
constraints:
1 <= |tasks| <= 10^4
0 <= N <= 100
Tasks are uppercase English letters.
inputFormat:
The first line contains the task string (no spaces).
The second line contains N.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum number of intervals.

starterCode.python:
tasks = list(input().strip())
n = int(input())
